entities.summary: Parsa Pirouzfar (b. 1972-09-13, Tehran) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tehran and Iran. Known in the fields of iran, poets & playwrights, asia.
